tripRule: Trips are as reported in the covering email, which supersedes the workbook derivation.
movementRule: One movement is one transfer between locations: port to rig, rig to port, or rig to rig. Repositioning at the rig already occupied does not count, nor does a shift between two port-side locations.

trucks.rule: Count truck and pickup units per movement. A dispatch counts as out, an arrival counts as in. An offload of a unit already counted on arrival is not a second movement, and a duplicated row sharing a delivery ticket is counted once.

dataNotes: Pipe yard truck moves: 70 or 52. The same open question as report 28, larger this week. Fifteen lines, carrying 18 trucks, are moves between the Shuaiba Port pipe yard and the berth, written as dispatches or arrivals, so the rule counts them. If no move inside the port counts, the total is 52, not 70.

Vessel trips: email 16. The email reports CA1 4, CA3 2, CA5 3, Charlie-3 7. On the Vessel sheet Charlie-3 casts off from berth 4 seven times; CA1 and CA3 each leave Shuaiba for OD1 once, and CA5 twice. The email's figures are used, per the standing rule.

Fresh or drill water. The Port sheet calls every water bunkering fresh water. The Vessel sheet calls 504 m³ (CA1, 09.10), 594 m³ (CA3, 10.10) and 180 m³ (CA1, 11.10) 'drill and fresh water' with no split, and 40 m³ (CA5, 08.10) drill water. The Port sheet's word is used unless the Vessel sheet splits the figure or is the only record. The water total, 1,772 m³, is the same either way.
Port E30 (09.10) repeats E16 (08.10): 40 m³ of water to CA5. The Vessel sheet has CA5 at OD1 for all of 09.10. Counted once, on 08.10.
CA1 fuel on 09.10: 144 or 180 m³. Port E27 records four 36,000 L tankers and E31 144.008 m³. Vessel E8 records 180 m³. 144.008 is used.
Bentonite 45.26 MT on 11.10: CA3 or CA1. Port E61 says CA3; Vessel E16 says CA1. Not in the cubic-metre totals.

Three repeated rows counted once: E37 repeats E36 (HPM-DT-1608), E91 restates E89 (OWS-DT-DRT-087), E104 repeats E103 (BAR-DT-12B; the email lists that one twice as well). If each was a separate truck, inbound moves are 50, not 47.

Delivery tickets used for more than one truck, counted as separate trucks: RM-SP-9049 (E4 on 08.10 and E18 on 09.10), RM-SP-9057 (E32, E33), HPM-DT-1610 (E49, E50, E54), HPM-DT-1612 (E71, E72), OWS-DT-TRS-081 (E8, E9, E10).
Collection runs. E17, E18 with E24, and E19 describe trucks sent out empty to collect cargo and coming back. The loaded leg is counted, not both legs.
Port E93: two trucks offloaded from KOC Yard 5 with no arrival line. Counted as two arrivals, as report 25 counted E61.
Port E52: a boom truck from OWS to Weatherford, both at Mina Abdallah. It never reaches the port, so it is not counted.
Two summary lines disagree with the detail. E15 (08.10) says 5 trucks arrived; the detail shows 6. E106 (14.10) says 2 trucks were loaded for Odfjell; the detail shows 1.
